mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM study_task WHERE plan_date BETWEEN #{weekStart} AND #{weekEnd} AND deleted = 0 UNION SELECT user_id FROM chat_message WHERE role = 'user' AND create_time >= #{rangeStart} AND create_time < #{rangeEnd} UNION SELECT user_id FROM user_study_goal WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY user_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_tasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_tasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN estimated_minutes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS study_minutes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at < #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_tasks FROM study_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND plan_date BETWEEN #{weekStart} AND #{weekEnd} AND deleted = 0

SELECT subject, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at < #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_tasks FROM study_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND plan_date BETWEEN #{weekStart} AND #{weekEnd} AND deleted = 0 AND status != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY subject ORDER BY subject
